_about: Phase 4 attribution registry. Keys are 'chain:address' (lowercase) for per-address verdicts and 'family:<codehash>' for bytecode families (METHOD §5: a family is the unit of attribution, one verdict covers every member). A per-address entry overrides its family. Every entry carries actor_type per METHOD §3 Axis B and, where applicable, protocol + category + confidence + evidence. Confidence semantics are the parent census's (results/REPORT.md §5): high = both sides verified on-chain/source or an exact registry match; medium = verified name on one side, project inferred; low = name-only or single tx. is_system addresses (METHOD §3) get NO actor_type here — precedence is enforced in build_outputs.py, not by omitting them.
_families_by_prefix: keys are the first 8 hex chars of the family's sha256 clustering codehash; build_outputs.py resolves each prefix against the code caches and ABORTS if a prefix matches zero or more than one family, so a stale prefix can never silently attribute nothing.
